item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs shing / slar bsod nams can stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse la shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa'i b+he dza yA//
